GitHub Pages Settings - What You Should See
============================================

Navigate to: Settings → Pages

WRONG Configuration (showing README):
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Build and deployment                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Source                                  │
│ ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ Deploy from a branch            [▼] │ │
│ └─────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                         │
│ Branch                                  │
│ ┌──────┐  ┌────────┐                  │
│ │ main │  │ /(root)│  [Save]          │
│ └──────┘  └────────┘                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
                  ↑
            THIS IS WRONG!
        (Deploys README.md)


CORRECT Configuration (showing wiki):
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Build and deployment                    │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Source                                  │
│ ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ GitHub Actions              [▼] │ │
│ └─────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                         │
│ ⚡ Your GitHub Actions workflow is      │
│    deploying to this site.              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
                  ↑
            THIS IS CORRECT!
        (Deploys wiki-output/)


How to Fix:
1. Click the "Source" dropdown
2. Select "GitHub Actions"
3. The page will update automatically
4. Go to Actions tab and check latest workflow
5. Wait for deployment to complete
6. Visit your GitHub Pages URL

Your Pages URL should look like:
https://[your-username].github.io/DnD/

After changing to GitHub Actions and deployment completes,
you should see your D&D wiki homepage, NOT the README!
